symptom: spidev0.0 doesn't exist (/dev/spidev0.0: No such file). My MCP3008 ADC SPI code worked on the Pi 4 and fails on the fresh Pi 5 image.

dmesg_tail: spi-bcm2835: could not find an available device

gold.diagnosis: SPI is not enabled. Add dtparam=spi=on to /boot/firmware/config.txt and reboot; the spidev module then exposes /dev/spidev0.0 and /dev/spidev0.1.
